words.gloss_range: coordinating and resumptive connector at the ayah boundary
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as the earth-side counterpart to the preceding heaven clause (51:47). It does not merely restart the discourse; it coordinates the second member of a sky-earth pair while letting the lower-domain focus begin. Because it is bound into the following earth noun and heard through liaison, the connection is both structural and perceptible at the surface.

topics.headline: coordinated second cosmic member
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is the second panel of a heaven-earth pair, not an isolated new sentence.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates 51:48 with 51:47 while also marking the shift to the earth-focused member of the pair.

topics.headline: visible and audible bound onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector is not a detached label; it enters the word surface and sound of the earth opening.
topics.reason: Rows about fused onset, repeated wa-l opening, and liaison preserve the surface-level way the coordination is carried.

words.gloss_range: the definite lower cosmic domain, advanced as the acted-upon earth-surface
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, or lower surface; local grammar and the prior heaven clause select the known lower cosmic domain rather than territory or soil alone
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arḍa}}) names the known lower domain opposite the sky of 51:47. The canonical accusative makes it a fronted object resumed by the verb suffix, so the earth is both thematically advanced and grammatically acted upon. Variant case evidence keeps the topic-comment pressure visible, but the local reading remains object-fronting. The word also enters the prepared-surface field: the following spreading verb and closing preparer noun make the earth not merely a cosmic label but the surface made ready for habitation. Its return after 51:20 and 51:23 keeps an earth-thread alive inside the surah, and the heavier sound of the earth-object gives the opening a marked landing after the light connector.

topics.headline: known lower cosmic domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun points to the recognized earth-domain opposite the prior sky, not to an indefinite land or local terrain.
topics.reason: Definiteness, singular concrete form, and the 51:47 boundary select the lower cosmic counterpart; missing V4 root data is not negative evidence.

topics.headline: accusative object-fronting with variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth is placed first for prominence while the canonical case still makes it the object of spreading.
topics.reason: The nominative variant usefully exposes a topic-comment alternative, but the local canonical form is accusative ishtighal with the object resumed in the verb.

topics.headline: earth as prepared surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth becomes a habitable spread, not only the lower half of a cosmic pair.
topics.reason: The local object is treated by the spreading verb, and inter-ayah formulas connect earth with spread or cradle language (2:22; 20:53; 43:10).

topics.headline: paired panel and local recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word as a structural hinge: it is second member of the heaven-earth panel and part of the surah's earth thread.
topics.reason: The rows preserve vertical-to-horizontal pairing with 51:47 plus local recurrence in the surah at 51:20 and 51:23.

topics.headline: weighty acoustic landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the heavier audible arrival of the earth-object after the light connector.
topics.reason: The sound observation is modest but locally tied to the opening earth-object surface.

words.gloss_range: We spread it, with the sense of laying out or furnishing the earth as a usable surface
words.root_gloss_range: spreading, laying out, furnishing, bedding, and related spread-surface branches; the local perfect verb selects direct divine spreading of the earth, not marital, animal, insect, wound, or speech branches
words.prose: {{ar:فَرَشْنَٰهَا}} ({{tr:farashnāhā}}) compresses the whole event into one perfect active verb: the divine We acts, and the suffix resumes the already fronted earth. The perfect presents the spreading as a completed act that can immediately ground praise. The root image is tactile rather than abstract: the earth is laid out like a prepared spread or furnishing, while Form I keeps the action direct rather than iterative. Its rarity matters too: this is the root's lone verbal use in the supplied distribution, turning the earth-spread formula known from 2:22 into action and answering the sky-building cadence of 51:47 with a horizontal counterpart. Even the breathy fricative texture gives the spreading verb a modest sound-image, without making sound carry the meaning by itself.

topics.headline: completed act with agent and patient compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the whole event in one word: divine agent, resumed earth-object, and completed action.
topics.reason: The perfect active form carries first-person plural subject agreement and a feminine object suffix tied by attachment evidence to the fronted earth.

topics.headline: spreading as habitable furnishing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb pictures earth as a laid-out usable surface, not merely as terrain extended in space.
topics.reason: The accepted spread and furnishing branches survive through the earth object, while unrelated root branches are not locally activated.

topics.headline: rare verbalization of earth-spread formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar earth-as-spread field is made verbal here, making this act distributionally marked.
topics.reason: The supplied profiles mark the local form as the only perfect verbal instance, and the inter-ayah connection with the noun formula is concrete at 2:22.

topics.headline: direct Form I completed action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the selected action as direct and complete, not an ongoing or repeated furnishing process.
topics.reason: Contrasts with an imperfect or intensive alternative are useful only as limits around the actual Form I perfect.

topics.headline: act becomes basis for praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the spreading is not left as description; it is the material basis for the praise that follows.
topics.reason: The next clause is syntactically linked as a praise response, and the local root co-occurrence joins spreading, earth, and praise.

topics.headline: horizontal counterpart to sky-building
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb as the lower horizontal answer to the prior upward building act.
topics.reason: The shared cadence and parallel suffix pattern bind the earth action to the heaven action at 51:47 without making the two pronouns share one antecedent.

topics.headline: breathy spread-like sound texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a modest sound-image where the verb's fricatives suit the spreading action.
topics.reason: The row itself limits the sound point as iconic support, not proof of meaning.

words.gloss_range: then, so; a fused connector that moves from completed action into evaluative praise
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the ayah's hinge from report to praise. Sequentially, it makes the commendation follow without a pause after the spreading; consequentially, it makes the spreading the ground for that commendation. Because it is fused into the praise word, the reader meets transition and evaluation as one compact surface turn.

topics.headline: immediate consequence into praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that praise follows the act as both next beat and consequence, not as a detached sentence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the second clause as the praise response after the spreading, allowing both sequence and consequence.

topics.headline: fused rhetorical pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the surface snap from declarative action report into exclamatory evaluation.
topics.reason: The proclitic form and clause architecture make the particle carry the audible and rhetorical turn into praise.

words.gloss_range: invariable praise verb: how excellent; locally evaluative rather than a report of bestowing blessing
words.root_gloss_range: praise, favor, blessing, ease, softness, affirmation, livestock, and other branches; the local uninflected form selects the praise formula while favor and ease remain as root-family resonance
words.prose: {{ar:نِعْمَ}} ({{tr:niʿma}}) changes the mode of the ayah. It is not an ordinary conjugated past-tense verb but a fixed praise formula, so the line moves from the completed spreading to an exclamation of excellence. The formula identifies the praised agent through the following participle while the implied specification points back to the divine speaker of the previous verb. Its root-family links with blessing and ease sharpen the evaluation, but the local branch is praise: the word commends the preparers rather than narrating a new act of bestowing favor. The formula also joins recognized praise closures (8:40; 22:78; 38:30; 38:44), turns the bed-preparation field toward its positive pole, and in its clipped shape binds earth, spreading, and preparer into one evaluated complex.

topics.headline: fixed verb of praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is an exclamatory praise formula, not a normal past-tense report.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an uninflected praise verb governing the following praised term.

topics.headline: speaker becomes praised agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compressed self-commendation: the speaker who spread the earth is recovered as the praised agent.
topics.reason: The praise construction and the preceding first-person plural verb let the implied specification point back to the same divine speaker.

topics.headline: favor and ease resonance inside praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the praise is colored by a root-family of benefit and ease, while the local form still evaluates rather than bestows.
topics.reason: V4 supports praise, favor, and ease branches, but the local uninflected praise form selects evaluation and only lets blessing/ease color the payoff.

topics.headline: description turns into evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that evaluation is built into the ayah's structure instead of being an afterthought.
topics.reason: The word pivots the ayah from action report into exclamatory commendation of the actor.

topics.headline: recognized praise formula with polarity contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local formula joins known praise closures and turns the bed-preparation field toward the positive pole.
topics.reason: The formula comparison is valid with concrete praise parallels (8:40; 22:78; 38:30; 38:44), while the blame-formula contrast remains a polarity echo rather than a local blame sense.

topics.headline: praise binds the local complex
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clipped praise word binds earth, spreading, and preparer into one evaluated complex.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and sound rows preserve how the compact praise form sits between the longer action and agent forms.

words.gloss_range: the preparers or levelers, specifically the praised agents who make the earth a smooth habitable surface
words.root_gloss_range: cradle, bed, smoothed resting-place, preparation, and making-ready; local active participle selects the preparing agent rather than the prepared product
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ}} ({{tr:al-māhidūna}}) is the praised agent of the formula, not a modifier of the earth. Its definite masculine plural form routes back to the divine We of the previous verb while shifting into third-person praise. The root image is preparation of a bed, cradle, or smoothed resting-place, narrowed here to agents who make the earth habitable; under the praise formula, any negative bed-field contrast is turned toward excellent divine making-ready. The active participle is crucial: the ayah closes on the preparers, not on the prepared surface, echoing earth-as-cradle product wording (20:53; 43:10) while shifting attention to the producer. Its rarity and final position make the self-designation marked, and its -ūna cadence, near-synonymous spreading reinforcement, and closure pair lower-domain preparation with the upper expansion of 51:47.

topics.headline: definite praised agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun names the same divine speaker as the praised agent in third-person form.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the participle the subject or praised term of the praise formula, and the prior first-person plural verb supplies the referential route.

topics.headline: habitable cradle-preparation image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a making-ready image: the earth is smoothed for rest and habitation, not merely flattened.
topics.reason: V4 supports cradle, bedding, and preparation branches, while the local earth-spreading context narrows them to preparing a habitable surface.

topics.headline: positive pole of bed-field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root field that can describe a wretched resting-place is here turned toward excellent divine preparation.
topics.reason: Negative bed-field associations survive only as polarity contrast; the local governing praise word fixes the current use as positive.

topics.headline: active participle foregrounds maker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends on who prepares the earth, not on the bed or cradle produced.
topics.reason: The active participle form selects the agent role, shifting familiar earth-as-product language toward the producer; parallels include earth-as-cradle wording at 20:53 and 43:10.

topics.headline: marked sole active participle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this agent noun is distributionally marked, making the closing self-designation stand out.
topics.reason: The supplied distribution gives this as the only active participle occurrence for the root, so the rarity is retained without inventing extra branch activation.

topics.headline: lower-domain counterpart to upper expansion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final participle as the ayah's landing point and as the lower-domain answer to the prior upper-domain agent term.
topics.reason: The close of 51:48 generalizes the act into a praised agent quality and pairs lower preparation with the upper expansion named at 51:47.

topics.headline: cadence, echo, and spreading reinforcement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reinforcement at several levels: product echoes, near-synonymous spreading roots, and a full closing cadence.
topics.reason: The rows connect the participle to earth-as-product formulas, the local spreading verb, and the shared closing sound with the prior participle at 51:47.

topics.headline: plural form sustains divine self-reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the plural ending carrying continuity from the prior divine We into the third-person praised title.
topics.reason: The masculine sound plural form aligns with the majestic plurality already present in the preceding verb.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object at word 1, spreading action at word 2, praise at word 3, and agent noun at word 4 form one preparation claim.
baseline_models.mechanism: The earth is the lower plane opposite the sky; spreading converts it into leveled bedding, and the praise evaluates the agents' preparatory craft.

activation_trace.role: The lower region opposite the sky supplies the habitable lower plane.
Spreading and leveling supply the operation that makes the plane usable.
The formula of praise evaluates the quality of the preparation.
Prepared bedding and level ground supply the usable result.

changed_reading.before: The earth was made flat or broad.
changed_reading.after: The earth is intentionally converted into a leveled, usable lower plane, and the closing praise evaluates the craft of preparation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth and spreading action can describe living cover, while the praise and preparer noun admit animal and cradle imagery.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fertile soil sends out spreading vegetation that supports dependent grazing life; the cradle image makes the prepared earth a nursery rather than a static floor.

activation_trace.role: Fertile, growth-bearing soil supplies the productive substrate.
Vegetation spreading close to the ground supplies living cover.
Young, low livestock supply dependent animal life over that cover.
The livestock branch joins animal provision to the evaluative word.
The prepared infant cradle supplies the nursery relation.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a static carpet for human use.
changed_reading.after: The spread earth is a fertile nursery whose cover feeds and carries dependent life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four focus roots can jointly describe a place furnished before its occupants arrive.
baseline_models.mechanism: A large rug and household furnishing become a congenial place already laid down as an antecedent kindness; human occupancy follows the host's provision.

activation_trace.role: The large woolen rug image literalizes the earth as laid hospitality.
Furnishing and bedding supply the host's concrete preparation.
A place agreeing with its occupant supplies congenial lodging.
A prior benefaction supplies the temporal precedence of the host's kindness.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a neutral substrate later occupied by people.
changed_reading.after: The earth is hospitality furnished in advance, so occupancy begins in received kindness rather than self-provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier wind sequence makes habitability reversible: an unproductive airflow reduces things to decay and removes bodily standing, so a spread and leveled surface is an affordance upheld rather than an intrinsic permanence.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and leveling supply the normally supportive operation.
Prepared level ground supplies the support that can be withdrawn.
Wind and moving air supply the destructive medium.
The barren-wind image removes reproductive yield from that medium.
Worn decay supplies the terminal material state of the exposed things.
Bodily standing supplies the support-affordance explicitly lost.

structural_cues: The sequence 51:41-45 moves from a barren wind through decay to inability to stand before the focus verse restores a prepared surface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destructive wind, decay, and lost standing; I infer that the focus ground is maintained support rather than permanent property. A live alternative is that the earlier sequence is only a punitive precedent with no qualification of 51:48.

changed_reading.before: Prepared earth is a permanently available support.
changed_reading.after: Its capacity to bear life and standing is a contingent gift that destructive force can revoke.

context_deltas.mechanism: The furnished, congenial place becomes lodging granted for enjoyment over a bounded interval, not an ownerless or permanent home.

activation_trace.role: A place that suits its occupant supplies the lodging quality.
Prepared bedding supplies the place of temporary residence.
An extended grant for enjoyment supplies occupancy as permission rather than possession.
A thing's appointed interval supplies the lodging's temporal boundary.

structural_cues: The command to enjoy until a time in 51:43 occurs inside a sequence where the granted interval ends.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enjoyable use and a bounded time; I assign that temporal limit to the focus's lodging image. A live alternative is that the limit belongs only to the cited community and does not characterize earthly habitation generally.

changed_reading.before: The prepared earth reads as a settled and durable home.
changed_reading.after: It reads as congenial lodging furnished for a granted interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: A raised canopy is assembled and widened with strength while its opposite lower plane is spread and leveled; the following joined-pair image sharpens the two operations into complementary habitat construction.

activation_trace.role: The lower counterpart to the sky supplies the second plane of the habitat.
Spreading and leveling supply the lower-plane construction operation.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper canopy.
Joining parts into a structure supplies the canopy's assembly.
Concentrated supporting strength supplies structural capacity.
Expansion against constriction supplies the canopy's open span.
A companion joined to its counterpart supplies the relational link between upper and lower planes.

structural_cues: Verses 51:47 and 51:48 are adjacent parallel clauses with object-first sky and earth, first-person plural actions, and plural agent predicates.
The pair statement in 51:49 immediately follows the two construction clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upper canopy, assembled strength, open span, a lower counterpart, and joined pairs; I infer one complementary habitat system. A live alternative is that 51:49 states a general pairing rule without specifically pairing sky and earth.

changed_reading.before: Earth-spreading is an isolated feat of terrain shaping.
changed_reading.after: It is the lower half of a coordinated, load-capable sky-earth habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mapping of the sky root contributes first rain marking soil with vegetation; joined to fertile earth, spreading plants, deliberate creation, and paired companions, the nursery becomes an upper-lower generative exchange.

activation_trace.role: Fertile soil supplies the receptive lower substrate.
Ground-hugging vegetation supplies the spreading living response.
The prepared cradle supplies the nursery function of the coupled system.
The split-target image of first rain marking earth with plants supplies an upper-to-lower germination event.
Creative origination supplies the production rather than accidental spread of life.
Joined companions supply reciprocity between canopy and fertile ground.

structural_cues: The sky clause, earth clause, and pair clause occur consecutively in 51:47-49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split-target first-rain mark, fertile soil, spreading plants, creation, and paired companions; I infer a rain-to-growth arrow and reciprocal ecology. Live alternatives are that the split mapping is only lexical activation and that the pair statement remains nonspecific.

changed_reading.before: The earth acts as a nursery through its own fertile surface.
changed_reading.after: Its nursery function is relational: an upper source marks the lower substrate, which answers by spreading living cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The laid ground both permits embodied travel and invites heavy attachment; the next command reverses hospitality into traction for directed flight toward the worshiped one under warning.

activation_trace.role: Clinging and becoming heavy toward the ground supply the settlement pole to be resisted.
Traversing a path over a spread surface supplies traction and route.
Travel on foot supplies the embodied mode of departure.
Flight and escape supply urgent directional motion.
The worshiped one supplies the motion's destination.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the urgency.

structural_cues: The imperative of 51:50 follows immediately after the earth and pair statements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a walkable spread, weight toward earth, flight, destination, and warning; I infer that the furnished ground enables rather than terminates the journey. A live alternative is that the imperative changes moral direction without recoding the physical surface.

changed_reading.before: A furnished earth is chiefly a place to settle.
changed_reading.after: It is also a departure surface whose usability gives traction for flight toward God rather than attachment to the furnishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preparation of an affair becomes enabling infrastructure: created occupants receive benefit through reminder and use the prepared arena for subordinated service, so comfort is instrumental rather than terminal.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent good condition supplies the occupants' received advantage.
Preparing and setting an affair in order supplies functional infrastructure.
A reminder that makes something present supplies orientation within the prepared arena.
Benefit opposed to harm locates the gain with the reminded occupants.
Creative origination supplies the occupants' prior dependence.
Submissive worship supplies the arena's stated human function.

structural_cues: The benefit statement in 51:55 is followed by the exclusive purpose construction in 51:56.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, reminder, recipient benefit, creation, and worship; I infer that earthly usability serves orientation and worship. A live alternative is that purpose belongs to creatures while the earth verse remains a separate sign of power.

changed_reading.before: Earthly comfort appears to be the preparation's endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The prepared earth is an enabling platform for reminder and worship, with its comfort serving that use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The host-guest asymmetry becomes explicit: occupants do not feed the maker; apportioned sustenance comes from the provider, while gathered strength and a hard exterior underwrite the furnished ground.

activation_trace.role: Household furnishing supplies the prepared accommodation.
Gifted good condition supplies the hospitality's benefit.
Prior benefaction supplies the host's initiative before human labor.
Consumable sustenance supplies what humans cannot be furnishing to the maker.
Feeding another supplies the explicitly denied reversal of host and guest.
An apportioned gift supplies the provider's positive action.
Strength gathered like cord strands supplies independent capacity to provide.
The hard outer surface of earth supplies a material echo of provision underwritten by firmness.

strongest_changes: The adjacent sky and earth clauses become a complementary upper-lower habitat rather than unrelated feats.
The destruction sequence makes support contingent, while the timed enjoyment cue makes habitation a granted interval.
The purpose and provision sequence turns earth from an endpoint of comfort into a service platform furnished by an independent host.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive surprises came from resolvable side branches: the sky root's non-dominant first-rain mark activated a reciprocal nursery, the firmness root supplied a hard earth surface, and the later likeness branch looped matching back into bedding.
remaining_uncertainties: The explicit pairing of sky and earth is reader-supplied; the pair statement may remain general.
The punitive scenes may contrast with prepared ground without defining its ordinary status.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Lower ground is spread and made habitable.** `ء ر ض/B001` supplies lower ground; `ف ر ش/B001` spreading/leveling; `ن ع م/B003` the praise formula; `م ه د/B002-3` smoothed bedding and preparation. The sequence from built sky to spread earth establishes complementary surfaces. I infer **leveling + preparation -> stable field for creaturely life**. The praise concerns effective making, not decoration alone.
2. **The earth is cradle-like provision.** `م ه د/B001` supplies a prepared child's cradle, activated by birth in 51:28-30 and creation in 51:49, 56. I infer **prepared ground -> developmental support for dependent creatures**. This generative shelter reading remains distinct from simple topographic leveling.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:56's created beings made the cradle branch of `م ه د/B001` newly functional: prepared earth supports dependent life ordered toward a purpose.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Ground is an actively prepared reception surface.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ء ر ض/B001` is lower ground opposite the sky; fixed `ف ر ش/B001` is “spreading, leveling, and laying out”; fixed `ن ع م/B003` is praising as excellent; fixed `م ه د/B002` is “smoothed bedding or spread place,” with `B003` preparing and smoothing a matter. **Structural cue:** timed collapse and inability to stand precede (51:43–46), the spacious built sky immediately pairs with this ayah (51:47), and 51:49–53 move through paired creation, flight, exclusive worship, repeated rejection, and overflow. **Role and abduction:** spreading creates stable contact, smoothing removes impediment, and praise evaluates that preparation; I infer that the surface enables creatures to stand, move, remember, and choose direction. **Reading change:** earth is not passive location but fitted infrastructure for responsive life.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:49–53 made the surface decisional: pairing enables recollection, flight chooses direction, and rejection or overflow shows how prepared capacity can be misused.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yatak imgesini evlilik bağına taşıyarak kadını, kocayı veya yatağın sahibini anlatır; çocuk nesebinin bu bağa verilmesi ve evlenme ya da cinsel birliktelik anlatımları aynı hukuki-toplumsal çerçevededir.

concept_map.definition: Evlilik yatağı üzerinden eşlerden birini veya evlilik birliğinin sahibini anlatan bir mecazdır. Bu mecaz, çocuğun nesebini evlilik bağına verme, soylu bir kadınla evlenme ve bir kadınla cinsel birliktelik kurma ifadelerinde özelleşir.

facets.statement: Evlilik yatağı aracılığıyla kadını, kocayı veya evlilik birliğinin sahibini anlatmak.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın çizgisi küçük, yük taşımayan veya kesimlik evcil hayvanlardır. Bununla birlikte bir yorum sözü binilen hayvanla ilişkilendirir; bu nedenle tanım çoğunluk çekirdeğini korurken kaynak içi kapsam farkını açıkça sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, küçük ya da yük hayvanı sayılmayan evcil hayvan sınıfıdır; tek bir yorumdaki binilme açıklaması bütün dalın zorunlu ölçütü değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hayvan sınıfını verir ve onu küçük, yük taşımayan veya kesimlik olma ölçütleriyle sınırlar; başka dallardaki serme anlamı aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Küçük olan, yük taşımaya elverişli sayılmayan veya daha çok kesim ve yemek için ayrılan evcil hayvanlar sınıfıdır. Özellikle deve yavruları öne çıkar; koyun ve sığırın da bu sınıfa katıldığı, buna karşılık bir yorumda binilen hayvan bağlantısı kurulduğu belirtilir.

facets.statement: Küçük, yük taşımaya elverişli olmayan ya da kesimlik sayılan evcil hayvanlar.
Özellikle küçük develer ile bu sınıfa katılan koyun ve sığırlar.
Bir yorumda sınıfın, yere yakın olduğu için binilen hayvanlarla ilişkilendirilmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt küçük develer ile yük taşımayan veya kesimlik hayvanları merkeze alır ve koyunla sığırı da kapsama katabilir; bir yorum ise sınıfı binilme özelliğiyle açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı ama ayrı görünümü aynı dalda toplar: ekinin yere doğru yayılması ve ince küçük dal ya da çalı parçaları. Tanım bu iki görünümü tek bir belirsiz bitki anlamında eritmeden ayrı yüzler olarak korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki hayvan yapısı verir: devenin bacağındaki az ve övülen açıklık ya da eğrilik ile hörgücü olmayan deve. Dal başlığı bunları tek bir beden biçimi gibi gösterebilir; tanım iki ayrı yüzü açıkça ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bacak açıklığı az olduğunda olumlu, aşırı olduğunda kusurludur; hörgüçsüzlük ayrı bir biçimin anlamıdır ve küçük deve sınıfıyla karıştırılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın bacak açıklığı ile hörgüçsüz deve yüzlerini ayırır; dişi devenin eğri bacağını anlatan söz öbeği yalnız kendi yapısında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Devenin bacağında hafif, ölçülü ve olumlu sayılan bir açıklık, dışa eğrilik veya tam dik durmama durumudur; açıklık aşırılaşınca kusur sayılır. Ayrı bir biçimde hörgücü olmayan erkek deveyi de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Deve bacağında az, ölçülü ve olumlu sayılan açıklık veya tam dik durmama.
Dişi devenin bacağındaki dışa eğrilik ve bükülme.
Hörgücü bulunmayan erkek deve.
Bacak açıklığının azı olumlu sayılırken aşırı açıklığın kusur sayılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar deve bacağındaki az ve övülen açıklığı, dişi devenin eğriliğini ve aşırı açıklığın kusur oluşunu verir; hörgüçsüz erkek deve ayrı bir biçim olarak ayrıca aktarılır.

facets.statement: Soruya veya önermeye olumlu cevap verip onu doğrulama.

concept_gloss.text: evet diyerek onaylamak veya söz vermek

concept_map.definition: Dar kullanımda develeri, daha geniş topluluk adında ise deve, sığır ve koyun gibi otlayan evcil hayvanları gösteren hayvan varlığıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, dar adın deveye özgü veya ağırlıklı olduğunu; geniş adın ise deve, sığır ve koyunla birlikte otlayan evcil hayvanları kapsadığını gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: develer ve geniş anlamda otlayan evcil hayvanlar

error_profile.loses: Geniş adın sığır ve koyunu da kapsayan topluluk yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deve, sığır ve koyunun birlikte kapsandığı geniş kullanımlarda uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kuş türünde birleşir; ancak tekil ve topluluk adlarının erkek, dişi veya türün bütünü için kullanılışı konusunda kapsam farkı bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi döşek ve altlık anlamını, hazırlanıp ayak basmaya elverişli kılınmış yeri ve kolay, düz bir zemin çukurunu birlikte destekler. Verilen çerçeve, beşiğe özgü dar anlamdan daha geniş olan bu somut alanı doğru kurar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal somut bir döşek ya da elverişli kılınmış yüzeyle sınırlıdır; soyut iş hazırlama anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Üzerinde yatmaya, oturmaya ya da bulunmaya elverişli olacak biçimde serilmiş, döşenmiş veya düzlenmiş altlık ve yerdir; belirli kullanımlarda kolay ve düz bir zemin çukurunu da anlatır.

facets.statement: Döşek, yaygı veya başka bir şeyin altına serilen elverişli destek anlamını taşır.
İnsanların yararlanması için döşenmiş, ayak basmaya elverişli kılınmış yer ve zemin de aynı tasarımla adlandırılır.
Belirli yer kullanımında, çevresine göre alçak fakat kolay geçilir ve düz bir zemin parçasını gösterir.
Yatağı sermek ve bastırıp yatmaya elverişli hale getirmek, bu dalın eylemle kurulan görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, bir şeyin döşek veya altlık olması ya da bir yüzeyin serilip düzlenerek kullanıma elverişli kılınmasıdır. Zemin kullanımı bu çekirdeği kolay ve düz bir alçak yere kadar genişletir.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, durumu veya sonucu gerçekleşmeye elverişli olacak biçimde hazırlamak, önündeki engelleri gidermek ve düzene koymaktır. Yerleşip sağlamlaşma, dal çekirdeği değil, yalnız ayrı söz biçiminde tanıklanan sınırlı kaynak varyantıdır.

facets.statement: Bir işi ya da şeyi hazırlamak, yolunu açmak ve düzgün bir duruma getirmek çekirdektir.
İşlerin düzeltilip yoluna konması, hazırlama çekirdeğinin onarıcı ve düzenleyici görünümüdür.
Bir mazereti genişçe açıklayıp kabul edilebilir hale getirmek, belirli bir söz bağlamına bağlı kullanımdır.
Kişinin kendisi için gelecekteki bir iyiliği hazırlaması, yararlı sonucun yolunu önceden açma uzantısıdır.
Öznenin yerleşmesi, sağlam bir konum edinmesi veya iyice tutunması dal çekirdeği değil, yalnız ayrı söz biçimine bağlı kaynak varyantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar soyut hazırlamayı, ön açmayı ve düzene koymayı ortak merkezde birleştirir. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bağımsız ve olumlu bir eski iyilik adını değil, yalnızca bir kimsenin daha önce iyilikte bulunmadığını bildiren olumsuz bir söz kalıbını tanıklar. Dal korunabilir, fakat tanımı olumlu bir iyilikten bu iyiliğin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıplaşmış yargıya çevirmek gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam belirli olumsuz söz kalıbına bağlıdır; genel olarak iyilik, nimet veya yardım etme anlamı çıkarılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bir kimsenin önceden iyilikte bulunmadığını söyleyen kayıtlı olumsuz kalıpla sınırlıdır ve yalın bir iyilik anlamı üretmez.
